Specifically, if your usage exposed a way for users to provide unfiltered user input and have it returned to them as an encrypted cookie (ex. storing a user provided search query in a cookie) they could then use the generated cookie in place of other more tightly controlled cookies; or if your usage exposed the plaintext version of an encrypted cookie at any point to the user they could theoretically provide encrypted content from your application back to it as an encrypted cookie and force the framework to decrypt it for them. sources.translates_description: 在 OctoberCMS 1.0.468 之前的版本中，加密的 Cookie 值并未与其所属 Cookie 的名称绑定。这意味着，某些利用面向用户代码中其他理论性漏洞的攻击更容易成功（核心项目本身并不存在可直接利用的问题）。具体来说，如果你的使用方式会让用户提供未经筛选的输入并将其作为加密 Cookie 返回给用户（例如把用户提供的搜索查询存入 Cookie），那么他们可以将生成的 Cookie 替换到其他控制更严格的 Cookie 位置；或者，如果你的使用方式在任何时候向用户暴露了加密 Cookie 的明文版本，那么理论上他们可以把来自应用的加密内容再作为加密 Cookie 提交回应用，并迫使框架替他们解密。该问题已在 build 468（v1.0.468）中修复。

sources.original_description: Previously encrypted cookie values were not tied to the name of the cookie the value belonged to. This meant that certain classes of attacks that took advantage of other theoretical vulnerabilities in user facing code (nothing exploitable in the core project itself) had a higher chance of succeeding. Specifically, if your usage exposed a way for users to provide unfiltered user input and have it returned to them as an encrypted cookie (ex. storing a user provided search query in a cookie) they could then use the generated cookie in place of other more tightly controlled cookies; or if your usage exposed the plaintext version of an encrypted cookie at any point to the user they could theoretically provide encrypted content from your application back to it as an encrypted cookie and force the framework to decrypt it for them. Issue has been patched in Build 468 (v1.0.468). Apply octobercms/library@28310d4 to your installation manually if unable to upgrade to Build 468.

raw.current_description_en: In affected versions of TensorFlow under certain cases, loading a saved model can result in accessing uninitialized memory while building the computation graph. The MakeEdge function creates an edge between one output tensor of the src node (given by output_index) and the input slot of the dst node (given by input_index). This is only possible if the types of the tensors on both sides coincide, so the function begins by obtaining the corresponding DataType values and comparing these for equality. However, there is no check that the indices point to inside of the arrays they index into. Thus, this can result in accessing data out of bounds of the corresponding heap allocated arrays. In most scenarios, this can manifest as unitialized data access, but if the index points far away from the boundaries of the arrays this can be used to leak addresses from the library. This is fixed in versions 1.15.5, 2.0.4, 2.1.3, 2.2.2, 2.3.2, and 2.4.0.

sources.original_description: In affected versions of TensorFlow under certain cases, loading a saved model can result in accessing uninitialized memory while building the computation graph. The MakeEdge function creates an edge between one output tensor of the src node (given by output_index) and the input slot of the dst node (given by input_index). This is only possible if the types of the tensors on both sides coincide, so the function begins by obtaining the corresponding DataType values and comparing these for equality. However, there is no check that the indices point to inside of the arrays they index into. Thus, this can result in accessing data out of bounds of the corresponding heap allocated arrays. In most scenarios, this can manifest as unitialized data access, but if the index points far away from the boundaries of the arrays this can be used to leak addresses from the library. This is fixed in versions 1.15.5, 2.0.4, 2.1.3, 2.2.2, 2.3.2, and 2.4.0.
sources.translates_description: 在受影响的 TensorFlow 版本中，在某些情况下，加载已保存模型时会在构建计算图的过程中访问未初始化的内存。MakeEdge 函数会在 src 节点的某个输出张量（由 output_index 指定）与 dst 节点的输入槽位（由 input_index 指定）之间创建一条边。只有当两侧张量的类型一致时，这才是可行的，因此函数开始时会获取相应的 DataType 值并比较它们是否相等。然而，代码没有检查这些索引是否位于所索引数组的内部。因此，这可能导致访问相应堆分配数组边界之外的数据。在大多数情况下，这会表现为未初始化数据访问；但如果索引指向距离数组边界较远的位置，则可被用来泄露库中的地址。该问题已在 1.15.5、2.0.4、2.1.3、2.2.2、2.3.2 和 2.4.0 版本中修复。

sources.original_description: Under certain cases, loading a saved model can result in accessing uninitialized memory while building the computation graph. The MakeEdge function creates an edge between one output tensor of the src node (given by output_index) and the input slot of the dst node (given by input_index). This is only possible if the types of the tensors on both sides coincide, so the function begins by obtaining the corresponding DataType values and comparing these for equality. However, there is no check that the indices point to inside of the arrays they index into. Thus, this can result in accessing data out of bounds of the corresponding heap allocated arrays. In most scenarios, this can manifest as unitialized data access, but if the index points far away from the boundaries of the arrays this can be used to leak addresses from the library. We have patched the issue in GitHub commit 0cc38aaa4064fd9e79101994ce9872c6d91f816b and will release TensorFlow 2.4.0 containing the patch. TensorFlow nightly packages after this commit will also have the issue resolved. Since this issue also impacts TF versions before 2.4, we will patch all releases between 1.15 and 2.3 inclusive.

raw.current_description_en: Spinnaker is an open source, multi-cloud continuous delivery platform. In affected versions of Spinnaker, sensitive information from configured artifacts and triggers may be inadvertently exposed in pipeline execution logs. The artifacts and triggers in question are limited to AWS credentials provided using fields that are not intended to be identifiers, and not all execution logs are impacted. For example, the AWS credentials of Packer builds configured using the `cloudProvider` and `amiName` fields, and AWS credentials of Docker image builds configured using the `buildContext` and `repository` fields, would be exposed in pipeline execution logs. This issue is patched in versions 1.28.4 and 1.29.2.

raw.current_description_en: FastAPI is a web framework for building APIs with Python 3.6+ based on standard Python type hints. FastAPI versions lower than 0.65.2 that used cookies for authentication in path operations that received JSON payloads sent by browsers were vulnerable to a Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attack. In versions lower than 0.65.2, FastAPI would try to read the request payload as JSON even if the content-type header sent was not set to application/json or a compatible JSON media type. This would allow browsers to send requests to the vulnerable applications that the receiver would be able to process as JSON, allowing for CSRF attacks. The fixed version is 0.65.2.

In versions lower than 0.65.2, FastAPI would try to read the request payload as JSON even if the content-type header sent was not set to application/json or a compatible JSON media type. This would allow browsers to send requests to the vulnerable applications that the receiver would be able to process as JSON, allowing for CSRF attacks. The fixed version is 0.65.2.

raw.current_description_en: Git is a revision control system. Prior to versions 2.30.9, 2.31.8, 2.32.7, 2.33.8, 2.34.8, 2.35.8, 2.36.6, 2.37.7, 2.38.5, 2.39.3, and 2.40.1, by feeding specially crafted input to `git apply --reject`, a path outside the working tree can be overwritten with partially controlled contents corresponding to the rejected hunks from the given patch. A fix has been prepared in the versions published on April 25, 2023. As a workaround, avoid using `git apply` with `--reject` when applying patches from an untrusted source. Use `git apply --stat` to inspect a patch before applying; avoid applying one that creates a conflict where a link corresponding to the `*.rej` file exists.

raw.current_description_en: TZInfo is a Ruby library that provides access to time zone data and allows times to be converted using time zone rules. raw.current_description_en: This affects the package total.js before 3.4.7. The issue occurs in the image.pipe and image.stream functions. The type parameter is used to build the command that is then executed using child_process.spawn. The issue occurs because child_process.spawn is called with the option shell set to true and because the type parameter is not properly sanitized.

raw.current_description_en: TensorFlow is an end-to-end open source platform for machine learning. In affected versions an attacker can cause undefined behavior via binding a reference to null pointer in all operations of type `tf.raw_ops.MatrixDiagV*`. The implementation has incomplete validation that the value of `k` is a valid tensor.

sources.original_description: TensorFlow is an end-to-end open source platform for machine learning. In affected versions an attacker can cause undefined behavior via binding a reference to null pointer in all operations of type `tf.raw_ops.MatrixDiagV*`. The implementation has incomplete validation that the value of `k` is a valid tensor.
sources.translates_description: TensorFlow 是一个端到端的开源机器学习平台。在受影响版本中，攻击者可通过在所有 `tf.raw_ops.MatrixDiagV*` 类型操作中将引用绑定到空指针来造成未定义行为。其实现对 `k` 的值是否为有效张量的校验不完整。

sources.original_description: The implementation has incomplete validation that the value of `k` is a valid tensor. We have check that this value is either a scalar or a vector, but there is no check for the number of elements. If this is an empty tensor, then code that accesses the first element of the tensor is wrong. We have patched the issue in GitHub commit f2a673bd34f0d64b8e40a551ac78989d16daad09. The fix will be included in TensorFlow 2.6.0. We will also cherrypick this commit on TensorFlow 2.5.1, TensorFlow 2.4.3, and TensorFlow 2.3.4, as these are also affected and still in supported range.
sources.translates_description: 该实现对 `k` 的值是否为有效张量的校验不完整。我们检查了该值是否为标量或向量，但没有检查元素个数。如果它是一个空张量，那么访问该张量第一个元素的代码就是错误的。我们已在 GitHub 提交 f2a673bd34f0d64b8e40a551ac78989d16daad09 中修复该问题。修复将包含在 TensorFlow 2.6.0 中。由于 TensorFlow 2.5.1、2.4.3 和 2.3.4 也受影响且仍在支持范围内，我们还会将该提交回移植到这些版本。

raw.current_description_en: Gradio is an open source framework for building interactive machine learning models and demos. In versions prior to 2.5.0 there is a vulnerability that affects anyone who creates and publicly shares Gradio interfaces. File paths are not restricted and users who receive a Gradio link can access any files on the host computer if they know the file names or file paths. This is limited only by the host operating system. Paths are opened in read only mode. The problem has been patched in gradio 2.5.0.

raw.current_description_en: TensorFlow is an open source platform for machine learning. raw.current_description_en: capsule-proxy is a reverse proxy for Capsule Operator which provides multi-tenancy in Kubernetes. In versions prior to 0.2.1 an attacker with a proper authentication mechanism may use a malicious `Connection` header to start a privilege escalation attack towards the Kubernetes API Server. This vulnerability allows for an exploit of the `cluster-admin` Role bound to `capsule-proxy`. There are no known workarounds for this issue.

raw.current_description_en: Pimcore is an Open Source Data & Experience Management Platform: PIM, MDM, CDP, DAM, DXP/CMS & Digital Commerce. A path traversal vulnerability exists in the `AssetController::importServerFilesAction`, which allows an attacker to overwrite or modify sensitive files by manipulating the pimcore_log parameter. This can lead to potential denial of service---key file overwrite. The impact of this vulnerability allows attackers to: overwrite or modify sensitive files, potentially leading to unauthorized access, privilege escalation, or disclosure of confidential information. This could also cause a denial of service (DoS) if critical system files are overwritten or deleted.

This can lead to potential denial of service---key file overwrite. The impact of this vulnerability allows attackers to: overwrite or modify sensitive files, potentially leading to unauthorized access, privilege escalation, or disclosure of confidential information. This could also cause a denial of service (DoS) if critical system files are overwritten or deleted.
sources.translates_description: Pimcore 是一个开源的数据与体验管理平台，涵盖 PIM、MDM、CDP、DAM、DXP/CMS 和数字商务。`AssetController::importServerFilesAction` 中存在路径遍历漏洞，攻击者可以通过操纵 pimcore_log 参数覆盖或修改敏感文件。这可能导致拒绝服务，例如关键文件被覆盖。该漏洞的影响包括：覆盖或修改敏感文件，进而可能导致未授权访问、权限提升或机密信息泄露；如果关键系统文件被覆盖或删除，还可能导致拒绝服务（DoS）。

sources.original_description: A path traversal vulnerability exists in the `AssetController::importServerFilesAction`, which allows an attacker to overwrite or modify sensitive files by manipulating the pimcore_log parameter. This can lead to potential denial of service---key file overwrite. The impact of this vulnerability allows attackers to: Overwrite or modify sensitive files, potentially leading to unauthorized access, privilege escalation, or disclosure of confidential information. Tamper with system settings by modifying key files, such as the hosts file in Windows or configuration files for other services. Cause a denial of service (DoS) if critical system files are overwritten or deleted.
sources.translates_description: `AssetController::importServerFilesAction` 中存在路径遍历漏洞，攻击者可以通过操纵 pimcore_log 参数覆盖或修改敏感文件。这可能导致拒绝服务，例如关键文件被覆盖。该漏洞的影响包括：覆盖或修改敏感文件，进而可能导致未授权访问、权限提升或机密信息泄露；通过修改关键文件（例如 Windows 中的 hosts 文件或其他服务的配置文件）篡改系统设置；如果关键系统文件被覆盖或删除，还可能导致拒绝服务（DoS）。

raw.current_description_en: e2guardian v5.4.x <= v5.4.3r is affected by missing SSL certificate validation in the SSL MITM engine. raw.current_description_en: Zulip is an open source group chat application. raw.current_description_en: A security regression of CVE-2019-9636 was discovered in python since commit d537ab0ff9767ef024f26246899728f0116b1ec3 affecting versions 2.7, 3.5, 3.6, 3.7 and from v3.8.0a4 through v3.8.0b1, which still allows an attacker to exploit CVE-2019-9636 by abusing the user and password parts of a URL. The result of an attack may vary based on the application.

raw.current_description_en: The shape inference implementation uses `axis` to select between two different values for `minmax_rank` which is then used to retrieve tensor dimensions. However, code assumes that `axis` can be either `-1` or a value greater than `-1`, with no validation for the other values. We have patched the issue in GitHub commit da857cfa0fde8f79ad0afdbc94e88b5d4bbec764. The fix will be included in TensorFlow 2.6.0. We will also cherrypick this commit on TensorFlow 2.5.1, TensorFlow 2.4.3, and TensorFlow 2.3.4, as these are also affected and still in supported range.

raw.current_description_en: Exiv2 is a C++ library and a command-line utility to read, write, delete and modify Exif, IPTC, XMP and ICC image metadata. An out-of-bounds write was found in Exiv2 version v0.28.0. The vulnerable function, `BmffImage::brotliUncompress`, is new in v0.28.0, so earlier versions of Exiv2 are not affected. The out-of-bounds write is triggered when Exiv2 is used to read the metadata of a crafted image file.

raw.current_description_en: Squid is a caching proxy for the Web. Due to an Improper Validation of Specified Index bug, Squid versions 3.3.0.1 through 5.9 and 6.0 prior to 6.4 compiled using `--with-openssl` are vulnerable to a Denial of Service attack against SSL Certificate validation. This problem allows a remote server to perform Denial of Service against Squid Proxy by initiating a TLS Handshake with a specially crafted SSL Certificate in a server certificate chain. This attack is limited to HTTPS and SSL-Bump.

raw.current_description_en: The Aerospike Java client is a Java application that implements a network protocol to communicate with an Aerospike server. Prior to version 7.0.0, some of the messages received from the server contain Java objects that the client deserializes when it encounters them without further validation. Prior to versions 7.0.0, 6.2.0, 5.2.0, and 4.5.0 some of the messages received from the server contain Java objects that the client deserializes when it encounters them without further validation.

sources.original_description: The Aerospike Java client is a Java application that implements a network protocol to communicate with an Aerospike server. Prior to version 7.0.0, some of the messages received from the server contain Java objects that the client deserializes when it encounters them without further validation. Prior to versions 7.0.0, 6.2.0, 5.2.0, and 4.5.0 some of the messages received from the server contain Java objects that the client deserializes when it encounters them without further validation.
sources.translates_description: Aerospike Java client 是一个用于与 Aerospike 服务器通信并实现网络协议的 Java 应用。在 7.0.0 之前版本中，客户端从服务器接收到的某些消息中包含 Java 对象，而客户端在遇到这些对象时会在未做进一步校验的情况下将其反序列化。在 7.0.0、6.2.0、5.2.0 和 4.5.0 之前版本中，都存在这一问题。

sources.original_description: Issue: Unsafe deserialization of server responses ( GHSL-2023-044 ). The Aerospike Java client implements different ways of communicating with an Aerospike server to perform several operations. Asynchronous commands can be executed using the Netty framework using the `NettyCommand` class. This class includes an `InboundHandler` that extends Netty's `ChannelInboundHandlerAdapter`, which handles inbound data coming from the Netty channel established with the server.
sources.translates_description: 问题：服务器响应存在不安全反序列化（GHSL-2023-044）。Aerospike Java client 实现了多种与 Aerospike 服务器通信以执行多种操作的方式。异步命令可通过 Netty 框架并使用 `NettyCommand` 类执行。该类包含一个继承自 Netty `ChannelInboundHandlerAdapter` 的 `InboundHandler`，用于处理来自与服务器建立的 Netty 通道的入站数据。

sources.original_description: Deserialization of Untrusted Data in com.aerospike:aerospike-client. How to fix? Upgrade `com.aerospike:aerospike-client` to version 4.5.0, 5.2.0, 6.2.0 or higher.
sources.translates_description: com.aerospike:aerospike-client 中存在不可信数据反序列化问题。修复方式：将 `com.aerospike:aerospike-client` 升级到 4.5.0、5.2.0、6.2.0 或更高版本。

raw.current_description_en: The KEYS subsystem in the Linux kernel before 4.14.6 omitted an access-control check when adding a key to the current task's "default request-key keyring" via the request_key() system call, allowing a local user to use a sequence of crafted system calls to add keys to a keyring with only Search permission (not Write permission) to that keyring, related to construct_get_dest_keyring() in security/keys/request_key.c.

sources.original_description: The KEYS subsystem in the Linux kernel before 4.14.6 omitted an access-control check when adding a key to the current task's "default request-key keyring" via the request_key() system call, allowing a local user to use a sequence of crafted system calls to add keys to a keyring with only Search permission (not Write permission) to that keyring, related to construct_get_dest_keyring() in security/keys/request_key.c.
sources.translates_description: Linux 内核 4.14.6 之前版本中的 KEYS 子系统，在通过 request_key() 系统调用向当前任务的“default request-key keyring”添加密钥时，遗漏了访问控制检查。这使本地用户能够通过一系列特制的系统调用，向一个仅具有 Search 权限（而无 Write 权限）的 keyring 中添加密钥。该问题与 security/keys/request_key.c 中的 construct_get_dest_keyring() 有关。

sources.original_description: The KEYS subsystem in the Linux kernel before 4.14.6 omitted an access-control check when adding a key to the current task's "default request-key keyring" via the request_key() system call, allowing a local user to use a sequence of crafted system calls to add keys to a keyring with only Search permission (not Write permission) to that keyring, related to construct_get_dest_keyring() in security/keys/request_key.c.
sources.translates_description: Linux 内核 4.14.6 之前版本中的 KEYS 子系统，在通过 request_key() 系统调用向当前任务的“default request-key keyring”添加密钥时，遗漏了访问控制检查。这使本地用户能够通过一系列特制的系统调用，向一个仅具有 Search 权限（而无 Write 权限）的 keyring 中添加密钥。该问题与 security/keys/request_key.c 中的 construct_get_dest_keyring() 有关。

sources.original_description: It was discovered that the keyring implementation in the Linux kernel did not properly check permissions when a key request was performed on a task's default keyring. A local attacker could use this to add keys to unauthorized keyrings.
sources.translates_description: 已发现 Linux 内核中的 keyring 实现，在对某个任务的默认 keyring 执行密钥请求时，没有正确检查权限。本地攻击者可利用这一点向未授权的 keyring 中添加密钥。

sources.original_description: This compromises the validity of the keyring for those who rely on it. The KEYS subsystem in the Linux kernel omitted an access-control check when writing a key to a task's default request_key keyring. A local, unprivileged user could use this flaw to add a key to keyrings with only Search permission, thereby potentially compromising the validity of the keyring for those who rely on it.
sources.translates_description: 这会破坏依赖该 keyring 的用户对其有效性的信任。Linux 内核中的 KEYS 子系统在向某个任务的默认 request_key keyring 写入密钥时，遗漏了访问控制检查。本地未授权用户可利用该缺陷，向仅具有 Search 权限的 keyring 中添加密钥，从而可能破坏依赖该 keyring 的用户对其有效性的信任。

sources.original_description: The KEYS subsystem in the Linux kernel before 4.14.6 omitted an access-control check when adding a key to the current task's "default request-key keyring" via the request_key() system call, allowing a local user to use a sequence of crafted system calls to add keys to a keyring with only Search permission (not Write permission) to that keyring, related to construct_get_dest_keyring() in security/keys/request_key.c.
sources.translates_description: Linux 内核 4.14.6 之前版本中的 KEYS 子系统，在通过 request_key() 系统调用向当前任务的“default request-key keyring”添加密钥时，遗漏了访问控制检查。这使本地用户能够通过一系列特制的系统调用，向一个仅具有 Search 权限（而无 Write 权限）的 keyring 中添加密钥。该问题与 security/keys/request_key.c 中的 construct_get_dest_keyring() 有关。

sources.original_description: Eric Biggers discovered that the KEYS subsystem lacked a check for write permission when adding keys to a process's default request keyring, which could result in circumventing keyring restrictions.
sources.translates_description: Eric Biggers 发现，KEYS 子系统在向进程的默认 request keyring 添加密钥时，缺少对写权限的检查，这可能导致绕过 keyring 限制。

raw.current_description_en: discourse-bbcode is the official BBCode plugin for Discourse. Prior to commit 91478f5, CSS injection can occur when rendering content generated with the discourse-bccode plugin. This vulnerability only affects sites which have the discourse-bbcode plugin installed and enabled. This issue is patched in commit 91478f5. As a workaround, ensure that the Content Security Policy is enabled and monitor any posts that contain bbcode.

raw.current_description_en: TensorFlow is an end-to-end open source platform for machine learning. When a user does not supply arguments that determine a valid sparse tensor, `tf.raw_ops.SparseTensorSliceDataset` implementation can be made to dereference a null pointer. The implementation has some argument validation but fails to consider the case when either `indices` or `values` are provided for an empty sparse tensor when the other is not. If `indices` is empty, then code that performs validation results in a null pointer dereference.

sources.original_description: TensorFlow is an end-to-end open source platform for machine learning. When a user does not supply arguments that determine a valid sparse tensor, `tf.raw_ops.SparseTensorSliceDataset` implementation can be made to dereference a null pointer. The implementation has some argument validation but fails to consider the case when either `indices` or `values` are provided for an empty sparse tensor when the other is not. If `indices` is empty, then code that performs validation (i.e., checking that the indices are monotonically increasing) results in a null pointer dereference. If `indices` as provided by the user is empty, then `indices` in the C++ code above is backed by an empty `std::vector`, hence calling `indices->dim_size(0)` results in null pointer dereferencing (same as calling `std::vector::at()` on an empty vector). We have patched the issue in GitHub commit 02cc160e29d20631de3859c6653184e3f876b9d7. The fix will be included in TensorFlow 2.6.0.
sources.translates_description: TensorFlow 是一个端到端的开源机器学习平台。当用户未提供能够确定有效稀疏张量的参数时，`tf.raw_ops.SparseTensorSliceDataset` 的实现可能会解引用空指针。该实现做了一些参数校验，但没有考虑这样一种情况：对于空稀疏张量，只提供了 `indices` 或 `values` 其中之一，而另一个未提供。如果 `indices` 为空，那么执行校验的代码（即检查索引是否单调递增）会导致空指针解引用。如果用户提供的 `indices` 为空，那么上面 C++ 代码中的 `indices` 由一个空的 `std::vector` 支撑，因此调用 `indices->dim_size(0)` 会导致空指针解引用（类似于对空 `std::vector` 调用 `std::vector::at()`）。我们已在 GitHub 提交 02cc160e29d20631de3859c6653184e3f876b9d7 中修复该问题。修复将包含在 TensorFlow 2.6.0 中。

raw.current_description_en: HedgeDoc (formerly known as CodiMD) is an open-source collaborative markdown editor. An attacker is able to receive arbitrary files from the file system when exporting a note to PDF. Since the code injection has to take place as note content, there fore this exploit requires the attackers ability to modify a note. This will affect all instances, which have pdf export enabled.

raw.current_description_en: libcue provides an API for parsing and extracting data from CUE sheets. Versions 2.2.1 and prior are vulnerable to out-of-bounds array access. A user of the GNOME desktop environment can be exploited by downloading a cue sheet from a malicious webpage. Because the file is saved to `~/Downloads`, it is then automatically scanned by tracker-miners. And because it has a .cue filename extension, tracker-miners use libcue to parse the file.

raw.current_description_en: Tuleap is a Free & Source tool for end to end traceability of application and system developments. Affected versions are subject to a cross site scripting attack which can be injected in the name of a color of select box values of a tracker and then reflected in the tracker administration. Administrative privilege is required, but an attacker with tracker administration rights could use this vulnerability to force a victim to execute uncontrolled code in the context of their browser.

raw.current_description_en: A race condition was found in the GSM 0710 tty multiplexor in the Linux kernel. This issue occurs when two threads execute the GSMIOC_SETCONF ioctl on the same tty file descriptor with the gsm line discipline enabled, and can lead to a use-after-free problem on a struct gsm_dlci while restarting the gsm mux. This could allow a local unprivileged user to escalate their privileges on the system.

raw.current_description_en: @aedart/support is the support package for Ion, a monorepo for JavaScript/TypeScript packages. Prior to version `0.6.1`, there is a possible prototype pollution issue for the `MetadataRecord`, when merged with a base class' metadata object, in `meta` decorator from the `@aedart/support` package. The likelihood of exploitation is questionable, given that a class's metadata can only be set or altered when the class is decorated via `meta()`.

sources.original_description: @aedart/support is the support package for Ion, a monorepo for JavaScript/TypeScript packages. Prior to version `0.6.1`, there is a possible prototype pollution issue for the `MetadataRecord`, when merged with a base class' metadata object, in `meta` decorator from the `@aedart/support` package. The likelihood of exploitation is questionable, given that a class's metadata can only be set or altered when the class is decorated via `meta()`.
sources.translates_description: @aedart/support 是 Ion（一个 JavaScript/TypeScript 包的 monorepo）的支持包。在 `0.6.1` 之前版本中，`@aedart/support` 包里的 `meta` 装饰器在将 `MetadataRecord` 与基类的 metadata 对象合并时，存在潜在的原型污染问题。该问题被利用的可能性存疑，因为类的元数据只能在通过 `meta()` 对类进行装饰时被设置或更改。

sources.original_description: Possible prototype pollution for the `MetadataRecord`, when merged with a base class' metadata object, in `meta` decorator from the `@aedart/support` package. The likelihood is questionable, given that a class' metadata can only be set or altered when the class is decorated via `meta()`. Furthermore, object(s) of sensitive nature would have to be stored as metadata, before this can become a vulnerability. Has been patched in version `0.6.1`.
sources.translates_description: 在 `@aedart/support` 包的 `meta` 装饰器中，当 `MetadataRecord` 与基类的 metadata 对象合并时，可能发生原型污染。该问题被利用的可能性存疑，因为类的元数据只能在通过 `meta()` 对类进行装饰时被设置或更改。此外，只有在敏感对象被存储为元数据时，这一问题才可能成为真正的漏洞。该问题已在 `0.6.1` 版本中修复。

raw.current_description_en: Kanboard is project management software that focuses on the Kanban methodology. Due to improper handling of elements under the `contentEditable` element, maliciously crafted clipboard content can inject arbitrary HTML tags into the DOM. This issue has been patched in version 1.2.29.

raw.current_description_en: Tensorflow is an Open Source Machine Learning Framework. An attacker can craft a TFLite model that would cause an integer overflow in embedding lookup operations. Both `embedding_size` and `lookup_size` are products of values provided by the user. Hence, a malicious user could trigger overflows in the multiplication. In certain scenarios, this can then result in heap OOB read/write. Users are advised to upgrade to a patched version.

raw.current_description_en: A Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in significant-gravitas/autogpt version v0.5.0 allows attackers to execute arbitrary commands on the AutoGPT server. The vulnerability stems from the lack of protections on the API endpoint receiving instructions, enabling an attacker to direct a user running AutoGPT in their local network to a malicious website. This site can then send crafted requests to the AutoGPT server, leading to command execution.

raw.current_description_en: The __sys_sendmsg function in net/socket.c in the Linux kernel before 3.1 allows local users to cause a denial of service (system crash) via crafted use of the sendmmsg system call, leading to an incorrect pointer dereference.

raw.current_description_en: lxml is a library for processing XML and HTML in the Python language. Prior to version 4.6.5, the HTML Cleaner in lxml.html lets certain crafted script content pass through, as well as script content in SVG files embedded using data URIs. Users that employ the HTML cleaner in a security relevant context should upgrade to lxml 4.6.5 to receive a patch. There are no known workarounds available.

sources.original_description: There's a flaw in python-lxml's HTML Cleaner component, which is responsible for sanitizing HTML and Javascript. An attacker who is able to submit a crafted payload to a web service using python-lxml's HTML Cleaner may be able to trigger script execution in clients such as web browsers. This can occur because the HTML Cleaner did not remove scripts within SVG images in data URLs such as .
sources.translates_description: python-lxml 的 HTML Cleaner 组件中存在一个缺陷，该组件负责清理 HTML 和 Javascript。能够向使用 python-lxml HTML Cleaner 的 Web 服务提交特制载荷的攻击者，可能会在 Web 浏览器等客户端中触发脚本执行。出现该问题的原因是 HTML Cleaner 没有移除 data URL（例如 ）中的 SVG 图像内脚本。

raw.current_description_en: TensorFlow is an end-to-end open source platform for machine learning. An attacker can trigger undefined behavior by binding to null pointer in `tf.raw_ops.ParameterizedTruncatedNormal`. This is because the implementation does not validate input arguments before accessing the first element of `shape`.

sources.original_description: TensorFlow is an end-to-end open source platform for machine learning. An attacker can trigger undefined behavior by binding to null pointer in `tf.raw_ops.ParameterizedTruncatedNormal`. This is because the implementation does not validate input arguments before accessing the first element of `shape`.
sources.translates_description: TensorFlow 是一个端到端的开源机器学习平台。攻击者可以通过在 `tf.raw_ops.ParameterizedTruncatedNormal` 中将引用绑定到空指针来触发未定义行为。这是因为其实现会在访问 `shape` 的第一个元素之前，未对输入参数进行校验。

sources.original_description: Reference binding to null in `ParameterizedTruncatedNormal`.
sources.translates_description: `ParameterizedTruncatedNormal` 中存在将引用绑定到空值的问题。

raw.current_description_en: HtmlSanitizer is a .NET library for cleaning HTML fragments and documents from constructs that can lead to XSS attacks. In HtmlSanitizer before version 5.0.372, there is a possible XSS bypass if style tag is allowed. If you have explicitly allowed the `<style>` tag, an attacker could craft HTML that includes script after passing through the sanitizer. The default settings disallow the `<style>` tag so there is no risk if you have not explicitly allowed the `<style>` tag.

raw.current_description_en: Squid is a caching proxy for the Web. Due to an expired pointer reference bug, Squid prior to version 6.6 is vulnerable to a Denial of Service attack against Cache Manager error responses. This problem allows a trusted client to perform Denial of Service when generating error pages for Client Manager reports. Squid older than 5.0.5 have not been tested and should be assumed to be vulnerable. All Squid-5.x up to and including 5.9 are vulnerable. All Squid-6.x up to and including 6.5 are vulnerable. This bug is fixed by Squid version 6.6. In addition, patches addressing this problem for the stable releases can be found in Squid's patch archives. As a workaround, prevent access to Cache Manager using Squid's main access control: `http_access deny manager`.

This bug is fixed by Squid version 6.6. In addition, patches addressing this problem for the stable releases can be found in Squid's patch archives. As a workaround, prevent access to Cache Manager using Squid's main access control: `http_access deny manager`.
sources.translates_description: Squid 是一个 Web 缓存代理。由于存在过期指针引用缺陷，6.6 之前版本的 Squid 容易受到针对 Cache Manager 错误响应的拒绝服务攻击。该问题允许受信客户端在生成 Client Manager 报告错误页面时实施拒绝服务。早于 5.0.5 的 Squid 未经过测试，应假定为易受影响。所有 5.x 直到并包括 5.9 的版本都受影响，所有 6.x 直到并包括 6.5 的版本也都受影响。该问题已在 Squid 6.6 中修复。此外，稳定分支的修复补丁可在 Squid 的补丁归档中找到。缓解方法是使用 Squid 的主访问控制阻止对 Cache Manager 的访问：`http_access deny manager`。

sources.original_description: A flaw was found in Squid, resulting in a potential denial of service attack targeting Cache Manager error responses.
sources.translates_description: 在 Squid 中发现了一个缺陷，可能导致针对 Cache Manager 错误响应的拒绝服务攻击。

Welcome to phpMyAdmin 4.2.4, a bugfix version with minor security fixes.
- bug #4464 [security] XSS injection due to unescaped db/table name in navigation hiding
- bug #4465 [security] XSS injection due to unescaped db/table name in recent/favorite tables

raw.current_description_en: An issue was discovered in osTicket before 1.10.7 and 1.12.x before 1.12.1. CSV (aka Formula) injection exists in the export spreadsheets functionality. These spreadsheets are generated dynamically from unvalidated or unfiltered user input in the Name and Internal Notes fields in the Users tab, and the Issue Summary field in the tickets tab. This allows other agents to download data in a .csv file format or .xls file format. This is used as input for spreadsheet applications such as Excel and OpenOffice Calc, resulting in a situation where cells in the spreadsheets can contain input from an untrusted source. As a result, the end user who is accessing the exported spreadsheet can be affected.

raw.current_description_en: jQuery UI is a curated set of user interface interactions, effects, widgets, and themes built on top of jQuery. Versions prior to 1.13.2 are potentially vulnerable to cross-site scripting. Initializing a checkboxradio widget on an input enclosed within a label makes that parent label contents considered as the input label. Calling `.checkboxradio( "refresh" )` on such a widget and the initial HTML contained encoded HTML entities will make them erroneously get decoded. This can lead to potentially executing JavaScript code. The bug has been patched in jQuery UI 1.13.2. To remediate the issue, someone who can change the initial HTML can wrap all the non-input contents of the `label` in a `span`.

sources.original_description: jQuery UI is a curated set of user interface interactions, effects, widgets, and themes built on top of jQuery. Versions prior to 1.13.2 are potentially vulnerable to cross-site scripting. Initializing a checkboxradio widget on an input enclosed within a label makes that parent label contents considered as the input label. Calling `.checkboxradio( "refresh" )` on such a widget and the initial HTML contained encoded HTML entities will make them erroneously get decoded. This can lead to potentially executing JavaScript code. The bug has been patched in jQuery UI 1.13.2. To remediate the issue, someone who can change the initial HTML can wrap all the non-input contents of the `label` in a `span`.
sources.translates_description: jQuery UI 是一个构建在 jQuery 之上的用户界面交互、效果、小部件和主题集合。1.13.2 之前的版本可能受到跨站脚本攻击影响。当在被 `label` 包裹的 `input` 上初始化 checkboxradio 小部件时，父级 `label` 的内容会被当作该输入控件的标签文本。若随后对该小部件调用 `.checkboxradio("refresh")`，且初始 HTML 中包含经过编码的 HTML 实体，这些实体会被错误解码，从而可能执行 JavaScript 代码。该缺陷已在 jQuery UI 1.13.2 中修复。作为缓解措施，若可以修改初始 HTML，可将 `label` 中除 `input` 之外的内容全部包裹在 `span` 中。

sources.original_description: We're happy to announce the second patch release to jQuery UI 1.13 is out. It includes a security fix for the Checkboxradio widget, a few localization updates for Datepicker and some fixes for issues submitted by the community.

sources.original_description: jQuery UI is a third-party library used by Drupal. The jQuery UI Checkboxradio module provides the jQuery UI Checkboxradio library (which was previously in Drupal 8 core, but has since been removed from core and moved to this module). As part of the jQuery UI 1.13.2 update, the jQuery UI project disclosed following security issue that may affect sites using the jQuery UI Checkboxradio module: CVE-2022-31160: XSS when refreshing a checkboxradio with an HTML-like initial text label. Solution: Install the latest version. If you use the jQuery UI Checkboxradio module for Drupal 9, upgrade to: jQuery UI Checkboxradio 8.x-1.4.
sources.translates_description: jQuery UI 是 Drupal 使用的第三方库。jQuery UI Checkboxradio 模块提供了 jQuery UI Checkboxradio 库（该库此前属于 Drupal 8 核心，之后已从核心移出并迁移到此模块）。作为 jQuery UI 1.13.2 更新的一部分，jQuery UI 项目披露了以下可能影响使用 jQuery UI Checkboxradio 模块站点的安全问题：CVE-2022-31160，即在使用类似 HTML 的初始文本标签时，刷新 checkboxradio 可能触发 XSS。解决方案是安装最新版本；若在 Drupal 9 中使用该模块，应升级到 jQuery UI Checkboxradio 8.x-1.4。

sources.original_description: Cross-site Scripting (XSS) Affecting jqueryui package, versions <1.13.2+dfsg-1. How to fix? Upgrade `Debian:12` `jqueryui` to version 1.13.2+dfsg-1 or higher.

raw.current_description_en: Redis is an open source, in-memory database that persists on disk. An integer overflow bug in the underlying string library can be used to corrupt the heap and potentially result with denial of service or remote code execution. The vulnerability involves changing the default proto-max-bulk-len configuration parameter to a very large value and constructing specially crafted network payloads or commands. The problem is fixed in Redis versions 6.2.6, 6.0.16 and 5.0.14. An additional workaround to mitigate the problem without patching the redis-server executable is to prevent users from modifying the proto-max-bulk-len configuration parameter. This can be done using ACL to restrict unprivileged users from using the CONFIG SET command.

sources.original_description: The problem is fixed in Redis versions 6.2.6, 6.0.16 and 5.0.14. An additional workaround to mitigate the problem without patching the redis-server executable is to prevent users from modifying the proto-max-bulk-len configuration parameter. This can be done using ACL to restrict unprivileged users from using the CONFIG SET command.
sources.translates_description: 该问题已在 Redis 6.2.6、6.0.16 和 5.0.14 中修复。若暂时无法为 redis-server 可执行文件打补丁，一个额外的缓解办法是阻止用户修改 proto-max-bulk-len 配置参数；可通过 ACL 限制非特权用户使用 CONFIG SET 命令。

sources.original_description: It was discovered that Redis incorrectly handled some configuration parameters with specially crafted network payloads. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code. Vulnerabilities CVE-2021-32627 and CVE-2021-41099 only affected Ubuntu 18.04 ESM and Ubuntu 20.04 ESM.
sources.translates_description: 研究人员发现，Redis 在处理某些配置参数与特制网络载荷时存在错误。远程攻击者可能利用该问题造成拒绝服务，或执行任意代码。漏洞 CVE-2021-32627 和 CVE-2021-41099 仅影响 Ubuntu 18.04 ESM 与 Ubuntu 20.04 ESM。

sources.original_description: Description Redis is an open source, in-memory database that persists on disk. An integer overflow bug in the underlying string library can be used to corrupt the heap and potentially result with denial of service or remote code execution. The vulnerability involves changing the default proto-max-bulk-len configuration parameter to a very large value and constructing specially crafted network payloads or commands. The problem is fixed in Redis versions 6.2.6, 6.0.16 and 5.0.14.
sources.translates_description: 描述：Redis 是一个开源的内存数据库，并可将数据持久化到磁盘。其底层字符串库中存在整数溢出缺陷，可导致堆内存破坏，并可能进一步造成拒绝服务或远程代码执行。该漏洞涉及将默认的 proto-max-bulk-len 配置参数设置为一个非常大的值，并构造特制的网络载荷或命令进行利用。该问题已在 Redis 6.2.6、6.0.16 和 5.0.14 中修复。

raw.current_description_en: ext/intl/msgformat/msgformat_format.c in PHP before 5.6.26 and 7.x before 7.0.11 does not properly restrict the locale length provided to the Locale class in the ICU library, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (application crash) or possibly have unspecified other impact via a MessageFormatter::formatMessage call with a long first argument.

raw.current_description_en: Perl before 5.30.3 on 32-bit platforms allows a heap-based buffer overflow because nested regular expression quantifiers have an integer overflow.

sources.original_description: Perl before 5.30.3 on 32-bit platforms allows a heap-based buffer overflow because nested regular expression quantifiers have an integer overflow.
sources.translates_description: Perl 在 32 位平台上的 5.30.3 之前版本中，由于嵌套正则表达式量词存在整数溢出，可能导致基于堆的缓冲区溢出。

sources.original_description: Perl before 5.30.3 on 32-bit platforms allows a heap-based buffer overflow because nested regular expression quantifiers have an integer overflow. An application written in Perl would only be vulnerable to this flaw if it evaluates regular expressions supplied by the attacker. Evaluating regular expressions in this fashion is known to be dangerous since the regular expression engine does not protect against denial of service attacks in this usage scenario.
sources.translates_description: Perl 在 32 位平台上的 5.30.3 之前版本中，由于嵌套正则表达式量词存在整数溢出，可能导致基于堆的缓冲区溢出。只有当 Perl 编写的应用会对攻击者提供的正则表达式进行求值时，才会受到该缺陷影响。在这种方式下求值正则表达式本身就具有风险，因为正则表达式引擎在该使用场景下无法防御拒绝服务攻击。

sources.original_description: Additionally, the target system needs a sufficient amount of memory to allocate partial expansions of the nested quantifiers prior to the overflow occurring. This requirement is unlikely to be met on 64bit systems.
sources.translates_description: 此外，目标系统还需要有足够的内存，用于在溢出发生前为嵌套量词的部分展开分配空间。这个条件在 64 位系统上通常不太容易满足。

sources.original_description: ManhND discovered that Perl incorrectly handled certain regular expressions. In environments where untrusted regular expressions are evaluated, a remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause Perl to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2020-10543)

raw.current_description_en: Netty is an open-source, asynchronous event-driven network application framework for rapid development of maintainable high performance protocol servers & clients. In Netty (io.netty:netty-codec-http2) before version 4.1.61.Final there is a vulnerability that enables request smuggling. The content-length header is not correctly validated if the request only uses a single Http2HeaderFrame with the endStream set to to true. This could lead to request smuggling if the request is proxied to a remote peer and translated to HTTP/1.1. This is a followup of GHSA-wm47-8v5p-wjpj/CVE-2021-21295 which did miss to fix this one case. This was fixed as part of 4.1.61.Final.

raw.current_description_en: Galaxy is an open-source platform for data analysis. An arbitrary file read exists in Galaxy 22.01 and Galaxy 22.05 due to the switch to Gunicorn, which can be used to read any file accessible to the operating system user under which Galaxy is running. This vulnerability affects Galaxy 22.01 and higher, after the switch to gunicorn, which serve static contents directly. Additionally, the vulnerability is mitigated when using Nginx or Apache to serve /static/* contents, instead of Galaxy's internal middleware. This issue has been patched in commit `e5e6bda4f` and will be included in future releases. Users are advised to manually patch their installations. There are no known workarounds for this vulnerability.

This issue has been patched in commit `e5e6bda4f` and will be included in future releases. Users are advised to manually patch their installations. There are no known workarounds for this vulnerability.
sources.translates_description: 此外，如果使用 Nginx 或 Apache 来提供 /static/* 内容，而不是使用 Galaxy 的内部中间件，则该漏洞可得到缓解。该问题已在提交 `e5e6bda4f` 中修复，并将被纳入后续版本。建议用户手动为其安装打补丁。该漏洞没有已知替代性临时解决方案。

sources.original_description: An arbitrary file read exists in Galaxy 22.01 and Galaxy 22.05 due to the switch to Gunicorn, which can be used to read any file accessible to the user under which Galaxy is running.
sources.translates_description: 由于切换到 Gunicorn，Galaxy 22.01 和 22.05 中存在任意文件读取问题，攻击者可读取 Galaxy 运行账户可访问的任意文件。

sources.original_description: This vulnerability affects Galaxy 22.01 and higher, after the switch to gunicorn, which serve static contents directly. Additionally, the vulnerability is mitigated when using Nginx or Apache to serve /static/* contents, instead of Galaxy's internal middleware.
sources.translates_description: 该漏洞影响 22.01 及更高版本中直接由 gunicorn 提供静态内容的 Galaxy 部署方式。此外，如果使用 Nginx 或 Apache 提供 /static/* 内容，而不是使用 Galaxy 内部中间件，则该漏洞可被缓解。

sources.original_description: run.sh directly exposed >=22.01 Vulnerable
sources.translates_description: 如果通过 run.sh 直接暴露服务，且版本 >=22.01，则属于易受攻击状态。

raw.current_description_en: go-libp2p is the Go implementation of the libp2p Networking Stack. Prior to versions 0.27.8, 0.28.2, and 0.29.1 malicious peer can use large RSA keys to run a resource exhaustion attack & force a node to spend time doing signature verification of the large key. This vulnerability is present in the core/crypto module of go-libp2p and can occur during the Noise handshake and the libp2p x509 extension verification step. To prevent this attack, go-libp2p versions 0.27.8, 0.28.2, and 0.29.1 restrict RSA keys to <= 8192 bits. To protect one's application, it is necessary to update to these patch releases and to use the updated Go compiler in 1.20.7 or 1.19.12. There are no known workarounds for this issue.

raw.current_description_en: The inclusion of the web scraper for AnythingLLM means that any user with the proper authorization level (manager, admin, and when in single user) could put in the URL http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/identity-credentials/ec2/security-credentials/ec2-instance which is a special IP and URL that resolves only when the request comes from within an EC2 instance. This would allow the user to see the connection/secret credentials for their specific instance and be able to manage it regardless of who deployed it. The user would have to have pre-existing knowledge of the hosting infra which the target instance is deployed on, but if sent - would resolve if on EC2 and the proper `iptable` or firewall rule is not configured for their setup.

raw.current_description_en: Revive Adserver before 5.1.0 is vulnerable to a reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability via the publicly accessible afr.php delivery script. While this issue was previously addressed in modern browsers as CVE-2020-8115, some older browsers (e.g., IE10) that do not automatically URL encode parameters were still vulnerable.

sources.original_description: Revive Adserver before 5.1.0 is vulnerable to a reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability via the publicly accessible afr.php delivery script. While this issue was previously addressed in modern browsers as CVE-2020-8115, some older browsers (e.g., IE10) that do not automatically URL encode parameters were still vulnerable.
sources.translates_description: Revive Adserver 在 5.1.0 之前版本中存在反射型跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，攻击面位于可公开访问的 afr.php 投放脚本。尽管该问题此前已在现代浏览器中以 CVE-2020-8115 的形式得到处理，但某些不会自动对参数进行 URL 编码的旧版浏览器（如 IE10）仍然易受影响。

sources.original_description: Security researcher Axel Flamcourt has discovered that the fix for the reflected XSS vulnerability in REVIVE-SA-2020-001 could be bypassed on older browsers with specifically crafted payloads to the publicly accessible afr.php delivery script of Revive Adserver. The practical applications are not considered particularly harmful, especially since the session cookie cannot be accessed via JavaScript.
sources.translates_description: 安全研究人员 Axel Flamcourt 发现，REVIVE-SA-2020-001 中针对反射型 XSS 的修复，在旧版浏览器上可被绕过；攻击者可向 Revive Adserver 公开可访问的 afr.php 投放脚本传入特制载荷。该问题的实际危害被认为相对有限，尤其是因为会话 Cookie 不能通过 JavaScript 访问。

sources.original_description: The previous fix was working on most modern browsers, but some older browsers are not automatically url-encoding parameters and would leave an opportunity to inject closing and opening script tags and achieve reflected XSS attacks e.g. on IE11.
sources.translates_description: 此前的修复在大多数现代浏览器中有效，但某些旧版浏览器不会自动对参数进行 URL 编码，从而留下了注入闭合和开启 script 标签并实施反射型 XSS 攻击的机会，例如在 IE11 上。

raw.current_description_en: Symfony is a PHP framework for web and console applications and a set of reusable PHP components. Starting in versions 5.4.21 and 6.2.7 and prior to versions 5.4.31 and 6.3.8, `SessionStrategyListener` does not migrate the session after every successful login. It does so only in case the logged in user changes by means of checking the user identifier. In some use cases, the user identifier doesn't change between the verification phase and the successful login, while the token itself changes from one type (partially-authenticated) to another (fully-authenticated). When this happens, the session id should be regenerated to prevent possible session fixations, which is not the case at the moment.

sources.original_description: Symfony is a PHP framework for web and console applications and a set of reusable PHP components. Starting in versions 5.4.21 and 6.2.7 and prior to versions 5.4.31 and 6.3.8, `SessionStrategyListener` does not migrate the session after every successful login. It does so only in case the logged in user changes by means of checking the user identifier. In some use cases, the user identifier doesn't change between the verification phase and the successful login, while the token itself changes from one type (partially-authenticated) to another (fully-authenticated). When this happens, the session id should be regenerated to prevent possible session fixations, which is not the case at the moment.
sources.translates_description: Symfony 是一个用于 Web 和控制台应用的 PHP 框架及可复用组件集合。从 5.4.21 和 6.2.7 开始，到 5.4.31 和 6.3.8 之前的版本中，`SessionStrategyListener` 并不会在每次成功登录后都迁移会话。它只会在通过用户标识符判断出登录用户发生变化时才这样做。在某些场景下，从验证阶段到成功登录阶段，用户标识符并不会变化，但令牌本身会从一种类型（部分认证）变为另一种类型（完全认证）。此时本应重新生成会话 ID 以防止可能的会话固定攻击，但当前并没有这样做。

sources.original_description: SessionStrategyListener does not always migrate the session after a successful login. It only migrate the session when the logged-in user identifier changes. In some use cases, the user identifier doesn't change between the verification phase and the successful login, while the token itself changes from one type (partially-authenticated) to another (fully-authenticated). When this happens, the session id should be regenerated to prevent possible session fixations.
sources.translates_description: SessionStrategyListener 并不会在每次成功登录后都迁移会话。它只会在登录用户标识符发生变化时才迁移会话。在某些使用场景下，从验证阶段到成功登录阶段，用户标识符没有变化，但令牌本身会从一种类型（部分认证）变为另一种类型（完全认证）。此时本应重新生成会话 ID，以防止可能的会话固定攻击。

sources.original_description: Symfony now checks the type of the token in addition to the user identifier before deciding whether the session id should be regenerated.
sources.translates_description: Symfony 现在在决定是否需要重新生成会话 ID 之前，除了检查用户标识符之外，还会检查令牌类型。

raw.current_description_en: NextAuth.js is a complete open source authentication solution for Next.js applications. In affected versions an attacker can send a request to an app using NextAuth.js with an invalid `callbackUrl` query parameter, which internally is converted to a `URL` object. The URL instantiation would fail due to a malformed URL being passed into the constructor, causing it to throw an unhandled error which led to the API route handler timing out and logging in to fail.

sources.original_description: NextAuth.js is a complete open source authentication solution for Next.js applications. In affected versions an attacker can send a request to an app using NextAuth.js with an invalid `callbackUrl` query parameter, which internally is converted to a `URL` object. The URL instantiation would fail due to a malformed URL being passed into the constructor, causing it to throw an unhandled error which led to the API route handler timing out and logging in to fail.
sources.translates_description: NextAuth.js 是一个面向 Next.js 应用的完整开源认证解决方案。在受影响版本中，攻击者可以向使用 NextAuth.js 的应用发送带有无效 `callbackUrl` 查询参数的请求，该参数在内部会被转换为 `URL` 对象。由于传入构造函数的是格式错误的 URL，URL 实例化会失败并抛出未处理异常，进而导致 API 路由处理器超时，并使登录失败。

sources.original_description: An attacker can send a request to an app using NextAuth.js with an invalid `callbackUrl` query parameter, which internally we convert to a `URL` object. The URL instantiation would fail due to a malformed URL being passed into the constructor, causing it to throw an unhandled error which led to our API route handler timing out and logging in to fail.
sources.translates_description: 攻击者可以向使用 NextAuth.js 的应用发送带有无效 `callbackUrl` 查询参数的请求，该参数在内部会被转换为 `URL` 对象。由于传入构造函数的是格式错误的 URL，URL 实例化会失败并抛出未处理异常，从而导致 API 路由处理器超时，并使登录失败。

sources.original_description: next-auth v3 users before version 3.29.5 are impacted. next-auth v4 users before version 4.5.0 are impacted.

raw.current_description_en: Flarum is an open source discussion platform. Flarum's page title system allowed for page titles to be converted into HTML DOM nodes when pages were rendered. The change was made after `v1.5` and was not noticed. This allowed an attacker to inject malicious HTML markup using a discussion title input, either by creating a new discussion or renaming one. The XSS attack occurs after a visitor opens the relevant discussion page. All communities running Flarum from `v1.5.0` to `v1.6.1` are impacted.

raw.current_description_en: Tensorflow is an Open Source Machine Learning Framework. raw.current_description_en: BigBlueButton is an open-source virtual classroom. raw.current_description_en: Tensorflow is an Open Source Machine Learning Framework. TensorFlow is vulnerable to a heap OOB write in `Grappler`. The `set_output` function writes to an array at the specified index. Hence, this gives a malicious user a write primitive. The fix will be included in TensorFlow 2.8.0. We will also cherrypick this commit on TensorFlow 2.7.1, TensorFlow 2.6.3, and TensorFlow 2.5.3, as these are also affected and still in supported range.

sources.original_description: If an application allows users to specify an unvalidated format for dates and passes this format to the `date` filter, e.g. `{{ last_updated|date:user_date_format }}`, then a malicious user could obtain any secret in the application's settings by specifying a settings key instead of a date format. e.g. "SECRET_KEY" instead of "j/m/Y".

SNDRV_CTL_IOCTL_ELEM_{READ|WRITE}32 is missing locks that can be used in a use-after-free that can result in a priviledge escalation to gain ring0 access from the system user. We recommend upgrading past commit 56b88b50565cd8b946a2d00b0c83927b7ebb055e

sources.original_description: A use after free vulnerability exists in the ALSA PCM package in the Linux Kernel. SNDRV_CTL_IOCTL_ELEM_{READ|WRITE}32 is missing locks that can be used in a use-after-free that can result in a priviledge escalation to gain ring0 access from the system user. We recommend upgrading past commit 56b88b50565cd8b946a2d00b0c83927b7ebb055e
sources.translates_description: Linux 内核的 ALSA PCM 模块中存在 use-after-free 漏洞。SNDRV_CTL_IOCTL_ELEM_{READ|WRITE}32 缺少必要锁保护，可被利用形成 use-after-free，并可能导致权限提升，使普通系统用户获得 ring0 访问权限。建议升级到包含提交 `56b88b50565cd8b946a2d00b0c83927b7ebb055e` 之后的版本。

raw.current_description_en: Scrapy is a high-level web crawling and scraping framework for Python. If you use `HttpAuthMiddleware` (i.e. the `http_user` and `http_pass` spider attributes) for HTTP authentication, all requests will expose your credentials to the request target. This includes requests generated by Scrapy components, such as `robots.txt` requests sent by Scrapy when the `ROBOTSTXT_OBEY` setting is set to `True`, or as requests reached through redirects.

sources.original_description: Scrapy is a high-level web crawling and scraping framework for Python. If you use `HttpAuthMiddleware` (i.e. the `http_user` and `http_pass` spider attributes) for HTTP authentication, all requests will expose your credentials to the request target. This includes requests generated by Scrapy components, such as `robots.txt` requests sent by Scrapy when the `ROBOTSTXT_OBEY` setting is set to `True`, or as requests reached through redirects.
sources.translates_description: Scrapy 是一个面向 Python 的高级 Web 爬取与抓取框架。如果你使用 `HttpAuthMiddleware`（即 `http_user` 和 `http_pass` 这两个 spider 属性）进行 HTTP 认证，那么所有请求都会把你的凭据暴露给请求目标。这包括 Scrapy 组件生成的请求，例如在 `ROBOTSTXT_OBEY` 设为 `True` 时发送的 `robots.txt` 请求，或者经由重定向到达的请求。

sources.original_description: Upgrade to Scrapy 2.5.1 and use the new `http_auth_domain` spider attribute to control which domains are allowed to receive the configured HTTP authentication credentials.
sources.translates_description: 请升级到 Scrapy 2.5.1，并使用新的 `http_auth_domain` spider 属性来控制哪些域名可以接收已配置的 HTTP 认证凭据。

sources.original_description: If you are using Scrapy 1.8 or a lower version, and upgrading to Scrapy 2.5.1 is not an option, you may upgrade to Scrapy 1.8.1 instead.
sources.translates_description: 如果你使用的是 Scrapy 1.8 或更低版本，而无法升级到 Scrapy 2.5.1，那么可以改为升级到 Scrapy 1.8.1。

sources.original_description: A security issue has been found in Scrapy before version 2.5.1. If you use HttpAuthMiddleware (i.e. the http_user and http_pass spider attributes) for HTTP authentication, all requests will expose your credentials to the request target. This includes requests generated by Scrapy components, such as robots.txt requests sent by Scrapy when the ROBOTSTXT_OBEY setting is set to True, or as requests reached through redirects.
sources.translates_description: 在 2.5.1 之前版本的 Scrapy 中发现一个安全问题。如果你使用 HttpAuthMiddleware（即 http_user 和 http_pass spider 属性）进行 HTTP 认证，那么所有请求都会把你的凭据暴露给请求目标。这包括 Scrapy 组件生成的请求，例如在 ROBOTSTXT_OBEY 设为 True 时发送的 robots.txt 请求，或者经由重定向到达的请求。

raw.current_description_en: An issue was discovered in fastecdsa before 2.1.2. When using the NIST P-256 curve in the ECDSA implementation, the point at infinity is mishandled. This means that for an extreme value in k and s^-1, the signature verification fails even if the signature is correct. This behavior is not solely a usability problem. There are some threat models where an attacker can benefit by successfully guessing users for whom signature verification will fail.

raw.current_description_en: calamares-nixos-extensions provides Calamares branding and modules for NixOS, a distribution of GNU/Linux. Users of calamares-nixos-extensions version 0.3.12 and prior who installed NixOS through the graphical calamares installer, with an unencrypted `/boot`, on either non-UEFI systems or with a LUKS partition different from `/` have their LUKS key file in `/boot` as a plaintext CPIO archive attached to their NixOS initrd. A patch is available and anticipated to be part of version 0.3.13 to backport to NixOS 22.11, 23.05, and unstable channels. Expert users who have a copy of their data may, as a workaround, re-encrypt the LUKS partition(s) themselves.

raw.current_description_en: In lunary-ai/lunary version v1.2.13, an incorrect authorization vulnerability exists that allows unauthorized users to access and manipulate projects within an organization they should not have access to. Specifically, the vulnerability is located in the `checkProjectAccess` method within the authorization middleware, which fails to adequately verify if a user has the correct permissions to access a specific project. Instead, it only checks if the user is part of the organization owning the project, overlooking the necessary check against the `account_project` table for explicit project access rights. This flaw enables attackers to gain complete control over all resources within a project, including the ability to create, update, read, and delete any resource, compromising the privacy and security of sensitive information.

raw.current_description_en: Sydent is a reference Matrix identity server. Sydent can be induced to send HTTP GET requests to internal systems, due to lack of parameter validation or IP address blacklisting. It is not possible to exfiltrate data or control request headers, but it might be possible to use the attack to perform an internal port enumeration. This issue has been addressed in in 9e57334, 8936925, 3d531ed, 0f00412. A potential workaround would be to use a firewall to ensure that Sydent cannot reach internal HTTP resources.

raw.current_description_en: cosign is a container signing and verification utility. In versions prior to 1.10.1 cosign can report a false positive if any attestation exists. `cosign verify-attestation` used with the `--type` flag will report a false positive verification when there is at least one attestation with a valid signature and there are NO attestations of the type being verified (`--type` defaults to `custom`). This can happen when signing with a standard keypair and with "keyless" signing with Fulcio.

raw.current_description_en: Requests is a HTTP library. Since Requests 2.3.0, Requests has been leaking Proxy-Authorization headers to destination servers when redirected to an HTTPS endpoint. This is a product of how we use `rebuild_proxies` to reattach the `Proxy-Authorization` header to requests. For HTTP connections sent through the tunnel, the proxy will identify the header in the request itself and remove it prior to forwarding to the destination server. However when sent over HTTPS, the `Proxy-Authorization` header must be sent in the CONNECT request as the proxy has no visibility into the tunneled request. This results in Requests forwarding proxy credentials to the destination server unintentionally, allowing a malicious actor to potentially exfiltrate sensitive information. This issue has been patched in version 2.31.0.

sources.original_description: Requests is a HTTP library. Since Requests 2.3.0, Requests has been leaking Proxy-Authorization headers to destination servers when redirected to an HTTPS endpoint. This is a product of how we use `rebuild_proxies` to reattach the `Proxy-Authorization` header to requests. For HTTP connections sent through the tunnel, the proxy will identify the header in the request itself and remove it prior to forwarding to the destination server. However when sent over HTTPS, the `Proxy-Authorization` header must be sent in the CONNECT request as the proxy has no visibility into the tunneled request. This results in Requests forwarding proxy credentials to the destination server unintentionally, allowing a malicious actor to potentially exfiltrate sensitive information. This issue has been patched in version 2.31.0.

raw.current_description_en: PrestaShop is an Open Source e-commerce web application. Prior to versions 8.0.4 and 1.7.8.9, the `ValidateCore::isCleanHTML()` method of Prestashop misses hijackable events which can lead to cross-site scripting (XSS) injection, allowed by the presence of pre-setup `@keyframes` methods. This XSS, which hijacks HTML attributes, can be triggered without any interaction by the visitor/administrator, which makes it as dangerous as a trivial XSS attack.

raw.current_description_en: OpenMRS is a patient-based medical record system focusing on giving providers a free customizable electronic medical record system. Affected versions are subject to arbitrary file exfiltration due to failure to sanitize request when satisfying GET requests for `/images` & `/initfilter/scripts`. This can allow an attacker to access any file on a system running OpenMRS that is accessible to the user id OpenMRS is running under.

raw.current_description_en: Requests is a HTTP library. Since Requests 2.3.0, Requests has been leaking Proxy-Authorization headers to destination servers when redirected to an HTTPS endpoint. This is a product of how we use `rebuild_proxies` to reattach the `Proxy-Authorization` header to requests. For HTTP connections sent through the tunnel, the proxy will identify the header in the request itself and remove it prior to forwarding to the destination server. However when sent over HTTPS, the `Proxy-Authorization` header must be sent in the CONNECT request as the proxy has no visibility into the tunneled request. This results in Requests forwarding proxy credentials to the destination server unintentionally, allowing a malicious actor to potentially exfiltrate sensitive information. This issue has been patched in version 2.31.0.

sources.original_description: Requests is a HTTP library. Since Requests 2.3.0, Requests has been leaking Proxy-Authorization headers to destination servers when redirected to an HTTPS endpoint. For HTTP connections sent through the tunnel, the proxy will identify the header in the request itself and remove it prior to forwarding to the destination server. However when sent over HTTPS, the `Proxy-Authorization` header must be sent in the CONNECT request as the proxy has no visibility into the tunneled request. This results in Requests forwarding proxy credentials to the destination server unintentionally, allowing a malicious actor to potentially exfiltrate sensitive information. This issue has been patched in version 2.31.0.

raw.current_description_en: PrestaShop is an Open Source e-commerce web application. Prior to versions 8.0.4 and 1.7.8.9, the `ValidateCore::isCleanHTML()` method of Prestashop misses hijackable events which can lead to cross-site scripting (XSS) injection, allowed by the presence of pre-setup `@keyframes` methods. This XSS, which hijacks HTML attributes, can be triggered without any interaction by the visitor/administrator, which makes it as dangerous as a trivial XSS attack.

raw.current_description_en: Calendarinho is an open source calendaring application to manage large teams of consultants. An Open Redirect issue occurs when a web application redirects users to external URLs without proper validation. This can lead to phishing attacks, where users are tricked into visiting malicious sites, potentially leading to information theft and reputational damage to the website used for redirection. The problem is has been patched in commit `15b2393`. Users are advised to update to a commit after `15b2393`.

sources.original_description: An out-of-bounds read vulnerability was found in Vim in the check_vim9_unlet function in the vim9cmds.c file. This issue occurs because of invalid memory access when compiling the unlet command when a specially crafted input is processed. This flaw allows an attacker who can trick a user into opening a specially crafted file into triggering the out-of-bounds read, causing the application to crash, possibly executing code and corrupting memory.

raw.current_description_en: In TensorFlow Lite before versions 1.15.4, 2.0.3, 2.1.2, 2.2.1 and 2.3.1, saved models in the flatbuffer format use a double indexing scheme: a model has a set of subgraphs, each subgraph has a set of operators and each operator has a set of input/output tensors. The flatbuffer format uses indices for the tensors, indexing into an array of tensors that is owned by the subgraph. This results in a pattern of double array indexing when trying to get the data of each tensor.

sources.original_description: In TensorFlow Lite before versions 1.15.4, 2.0.3, 2.1.2, 2.2.1 and 2.3.1, saved models in the flatbuffer format use a double indexing scheme: a model has a set of subgraphs, each subgraph has a set of operators and each operator has a set of input/output tensors. The flatbuffer format uses indices for the tensors, indexing into an array of tensors that is owned by the subgraph. This results in a pattern of double array indexing when trying to get the data of each tensor.
sources.translates_description: 在 TensorFlow Lite 的 1.15.4、2.0.3、2.1.2、2.2.1 和 2.3.1 之前版本中，flatbuffer 格式的保存模型采用双重索引方案：模型包含多个子图，每个子图包含多个算子，每个算子又包含多个输入/输出张量。flatbuffer 使用张量索引来访问由子图持有的张量数组，这会在读取每个张量数据时形成双重数组索引模式。

sources.original_description: However, some operators can have some tensors be optional.
sources.translates_description: 然而，某些算子中的某些张量可以是可选的。

The name of the patch is 39561c32c12cabe563de48cc96eccb9e2c655e25. It is recommended to apply a patch to fix this issue. VDB-213546 is the identifier assigned to this vulnerability.

raw.current_description_en: Node-RED 1.2.7 and earlier has a vulnerability which allows arbitrary path traversal via the Projects API. raw.current_description_en: The arch_pick_mmap_layout function in arch/x86/mm/mmap.c in the Linux kernel through 4.5.2 does not properly randomize the legacy base address, which makes it easier for local users to defeat the intended restrictions on the ADDR_NO_RANDOMIZE flag, and bypass the ASLR protection mechanism for a setuid or setgid program, by disabling stack-consumption resource limits.

sources.original_description: The arch_pick_mmap_layout function in arch/x86/mm/mmap.c in the Linux kernel through 4.5.2 does not properly randomize the legacy base address, which makes it easier for local users to defeat the intended restrictions on the ADDR_NO_RANDOMIZE flag, and bypass the ASLR protection mechanism for a setuid or setgid program, by disabling stack-consumption resource limits.
sources.translates_description: Linux 内核直到 4.5.2 版本中，arch/x86/mm/mmap.c 的 arch_pick_mmap_layout 函数没有正确随机化 legacy base address，这使本地用户更容易绕过对 ADDR_NO_RANDOMIZE 标志的预期限制，并通过禁用栈消耗资源限制来绕过 setuid 或 setgid 程序的 ASLR 保护机制。

sources.original_description: The arch_pick_mmap_layout function in arch/x86/mm/mmap.c in the Linux kernel through 4.5.2 does not properly randomize the legacy base address, which makes it easier for local users to defeat the intended restrictions on the ADDR_NO_RANDOMIZE flag.
sources.translates_description: Linux 内核直到 4.5.2 版本中，arch/x86/mm/mmap.c 的 arch_pick_mmap_layout 函数没有正确随机化 legacy base address，这使本地用户更容易绕过对 ADDR_NO_RANDOMIZE 标志的预期限制。

sources.original_description: Hector Marco and Ismael Ripoll discovered that the Linux kernel would improperly disable Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) for x86 processes running in 32 bit mode if stack-consumption resource limits were disabled. A local attacker could use this to make it easier to exploit an existing vulnerability in a setuid/setgid program.
sources.translates_description: Hector Marco 和 Ismael Ripoll 发现，如果禁用了栈消耗资源限制，Linux 内核会对以 32 位模式运行的 x86 进程不正确地关闭地址空间布局随机化（ASLR）。本地攻击者可借此更容易利用 setuid/setgid 程序中的现有漏洞。

sources.original_description: This issue affects the Linux kernel packages as shipped with Red Hat Enterprise Linux 5, 6.
sources.translates_description: 该问题影响 Red Hat Enterprise Linux 5 和 6 随附的 Linux 内核软件包。

raw.current_description_en: Multiple cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities in phpMyAdmin 4.4.x before 4.4.15.5 and 4.5.x before 4.5.5.1 allow remote authenticated users to inject arbitrary web script or HTML via (1) normalization.php or (2) js/normalization.js in the database normalization page, (3) templates/database/structure/sortable_header.phtml in the database structure page, or (4) the pos parameter to db_central_columns.php in the central columns page.

raw.current_description_en: Scratch Addons is a WebExtension that supports both Chrome and Firefox. Scratch Addons before version 1.3.2 is vulnerable to DOM-based XSS. If the victim visited a specific website, the More Links addon of the Scratch Addons extension used incorrect regular expression which caused the HTML-escaped values to be unescaped, leading to XSS. Scratch Addons version 1.3.2 fixes the bug. The extension will be automatically updated by the browser.

raw.current_description_en: ScanCode.io is a server to script and automate software composition analysis with ScanPipe pipelines. Prior to version 32.5.1, the software has a possible command injection vulnerability in the docker fetch process as it allows to append malicious commands in the `docker_reference` parameter. In the function `scanpipe/pipes/fetch.py:fetch_docker_image` the parameter `docker_reference` is user controllable.

raw.current_description_en: An issue was discovered in Podman in libpod before 1.6.0. It resolves a symlink in the host context during a copy operation from the container to the host, because an undesired glob operation occurs. An attacker could create a container image containing particular symlinks that, when copied by a victim user to the host filesystem, may overwrite existing files with others from the host.

sources.translates_description: 在 libpod 的 Podman 1.6.0 之前版本中发现一个问题。在从容器向宿主机执行复制操作时，由于发生了不期望的 glob 操作，它会在宿主机上下文中解析符号链接。攻击者可以构造包含特定符号链接的容器镜像，当受害者用户将其复制到宿主机文件系统时，可能会用宿主机上的其他文件覆盖已有文件。

raw.current_description_en: RIOT-OS, an operating system for Internet of Things (IoT) devices, contains a network stack with the ability to process 6LoWPAN frames. In version 2023.01 and prior, an attacker can send a crafted frame to the device resulting in an out of bounds write in the packet buffer. The overflow can be used to corrupt other packets and the allocator metadata. Corrupting a pointer will easily lead to denial of service.

sources.original_description: RIOT-OS, an operating system for Internet of Things (IoT) devices, contains a network stack with the ability to process 6LoWPAN frames. In version 2023.01 and prior, an attacker can send a crafted frame to the device resulting in an out of bounds write in the packet buffer. The overflow can be used to corrupt other packets and the allocator metadata. Corrupting a pointer will easily lead to denial of service.
sources.translates_description: RIOT-OS 是一个面向物联网设备的操作系统，包含能够处理 6LoWPAN 帧的网络栈。在 2023.01 及之前版本中，攻击者可以向设备发送特制帧，导致数据包缓冲区中发生越界写入。该溢出可用于破坏其他数据包和分配器元数据。破坏指针很容易进一步导致拒绝服务。

sources.original_description: During reassembling of 6LoWPAN packets `_rbuf_add` is used to add incoming fragments to the buffer.
sources.translates_description: 在重组 6LoWPAN 数据包时，`_rbuf_add` 会被用来把收到的分片加入缓冲区。

sources.original_description: In `_rbuf_add` the `datagram_size` is retrieved from the fragment.
sources.translates_description: 在 `_rbuf_add` 中，`datagram_size` 是从分片中提取出来的。

raw.current_description_en: The code for tf.raw_ops.SaveV2 does not properly validate the inputs and an attacker can trigger a null pointer dereference. The implementation uses ValidateInputs to check that the input arguments are valid, but execution continues from the next line in Compute that follows the call to ValidateInputs. The issue was patched in commit 9728c60e136912a12d99ca56e106b7cce7af5986 and the fix was planned for TensorFlow 2.6.0, with cherrypicks for 2.5.1, 2.4.3, and 2.3.4.

sources.original_description: We have patched the issue in GitHub commit 9728c60e136912a12d99ca56e106b7cce7af5986. The fix will be included in TensorFlow 2.6.0. We will also cherrypick this commit on TensorFlow 2.5.1, TensorFlow 2.4.3, and TensorFlow 2.3.4, as these are also affected and still in supported range.
sources.translates_description: 该问题已在 GitHub 提交 9728c60e136912a12d99ca56e106b7cce7af5986 中修复。修复将被纳入 TensorFlow 2.6.0，同时也会回移植到 2.5.1、2.4.3 和 2.3.4，因为这些版本同样受影响且仍在支持范围内。

sources.original_description: The implementation uses `ValidateInputs` to check that the input arguments are valid. This validation would have caught the illegal state represented by the reproducer above.

raw.current_description_en: An issue was discovered in the __ns_get_path function in fs/nsfs.c in the Linux kernel before 4.11. Due to a race condition when accessing files, a Use After Free condition can occur. This also affects all Android releases from CAF using the Linux kernel before security patch level 2018-07-05.

sources.original_description: An issue was discovered in the __ns_get_path function in fs/nsfs.c in the Linux kernel before 4.11. Due to a race condition when accessing files, a Use After Free condition can occur. This also affects all Android releases from CAF using the Linux kernel (Android for MSM, Firefox OS for MSM, QRD Android) before security patch level 2018-07-05.

raw.current_description_en: The Sentry API incorrectly returns the access-control-allow-credentials: true HTTP header if the Origin request header ends with the system.base-hostname option of Sentry installation. This only affects installations that have system.base-hostname option explicitly set, as it is empty by default. Impact is limited since recent versions of major browsers have cross-site cookie blocking enabled by default. However, this flaw could allow other multi-step attacks.

raw.current_description_en: Envoy is an open source edge and service proxy, designed for cloud-native applications. The envoy common router will segfault if an internal redirect selects a route configured with direct response or redirect actions. This will result in a denial of service. As a workaround turn off internal redirects if direct response entries are configured on the same listener.

sources.original_description: In versions 0.20210107 and prior of HyperKit, `vi_pci_write` has is a call to `vc_cfgwrite` that does not check for null which when called makes the host crash. raw.current_description_en: Cacti is an open source platform which provides a robust and extensible operational monitoring and fault management framework for users. raw.current_description_en: A privilege escalation vulnerability impacting the Google Exposure Notification Verification Server (versions prior to 0.23.1), allows an attacker who (1) has UserWrite permissions and (2) is using a carefully crafted request or malicious proxy, to create another user with higher privileges than their own. This occurs due to insufficient checks on the allowed set of permissions. The new user creation event would be captured in the Event Log.

sources.original_description: A privilege escalation vulnerability impacting the Google Exposure Notification Verification Server (versions prior to 0.23.1), allows an attacker who (1) has UserWrite permissions and (2) is using a carefully crafted request or malicious proxy, to create another user with higher privileges than their own. This occurs due to insufficient checks on the allowed set of permissions. The new user creation event would be captured in the Event Log.
sources.translates_description: 一个影响 Google Exposure Notification Verification Server（0.23.1 之前版本）的权限提升漏洞，允许同时满足以下条件的攻击者创建一个权限高于自身的新用户：（1）拥有 UserWrite 权限；（2）使用精心构造的请求或恶意代理。该问题源于对允许权限集合的检查不足。新用户创建事件会记录在事件日志中。

sources.original_description: Using a carefully crafted request or malicious proxy, a user with `UserWrite` permissions could create another user with higher privileges than their own due to insufficient checks on the allowed set of permissions.
sources.translates_description: 由于对允许权限集合的检查不足，拥有 `UserWrite` 权限的用户可以通过精心构造的请求或恶意代理创建一个权限高于自身的新用户。

sources.original_description: The issue has been fixed in 0.24.0 and 0.23.1.
sources.translates_description: 该问题已在 0.24.0 和 0.23.1 中修复。

raw.current_description_en: Vyper is a Pythonic Smart Contract Language for the ethereum virtual machine. In versions prior to 0.3.4 when calling an external contract with no return value, the contract address (including side effects) could be evaluated twice. This may result in incorrect outcomes for contracts. This issue has been addressed in v0.3.4.
